description: Error path: multiple published grid versions have overlapping effective windows and conflict for the given as_of timestamp. The engine refuses to silently pick one and returns a structured error requiring manual resolution.

ledger.description: Attempted to resolve published grid version for effective window

expected_response.error_message: Multiple published pricing grid versions conflict for the given effective window (as_of: 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z). Grid versions 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000060 and 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000061 both claim to be effective for product CONVENTIONAL_30_FIXED, investor INVESTOR_FANNIE_MAE, channel DIRECT_OWN, lock period 30 days. Manual resolution is required before base rate selection can proceed.
